name: article-maker
description: Turn any source — URL, PDF, DOCX, Markdown, plain text, screenshots, or pasted notes — into a beautiful, share-ready single-file HTML article that opens offline (with optional companion PDF). Bundles the article-maker skill: a Vite + React + TypeScript scaffold built on the reacticle component protocol (prose-first semantic components + a theme-token-constrained Raw layer), a source → plan → double-confirmation → build → review → repair harness with three hard collaboration checkpoints, 11 theme authoring profiles, article-type-driven information-retention defaults (longform ~100% … visual-essay ~40%), a 3:4 book-style cover, and an opt-in zero-npm headless HTML → PDF export.
